# OnStandard — Logo & Brand Law (v2, brand refresh 2026-07-31)

The **"Performance Dial"**: a score gauge reading at the very top of its scale (i.e. *on
standard*) whose silhouette also reads as the letter "O". Founder-approved refresh
2026-07-31: the geometry is unchanged; the mark gained a second official finish — the
**lit** dial ("F2 Balanced") — and every legacy variant was retired.

**Source of truth is `assets/brand/` — nothing else.** Every raster is generated by
`node scripts/gen-brand-assets.mjs`. Do not hand-copy SVG into new surfaces; embed one of
the canonical snippets below or reference a generated asset. (The old
`src/brand/Logo.tsx` this doc used to cite drew a different mark and was deleted.)

## Geometry (viewBox `0 0 100 100`, `fill="none"`) — LAW, never redraw

Dial center `(50,52)`, radius `34`, stroke width `12`, round caps.

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Track arc (gap at bottom) | `<path d="M33 81.4 A34 34 0 1 1 67 81.4" .../>` |
| Progress arc (sweep to the top marker) | `<path d="M33 81.4 A34 34 0 0 1 50 18" .../>` |
| Marker bezel | `<circle cx=50 cy=18 r=10.5 />` |
| Marker core | `<circle cx=50 cy=18 r=6 />` |

**Signature sweep** (founder-ratified 2026-07-14): `#34D399 → #22D3EE → #60A5FA`
(green → teal → blue), directional `x1=26 y1=82 x2=58 y2=18` (userSpaceOnUse) — green at
the arc's base, blue at the marker. On light surfaces end at `#3B82F6` for contrast.

## The two finishes — one geometry

| Finish | Master | Where it's used |
|---|---|---|
| **Lit** (F2 Balanced) | `assets/brand/dial-lit.svg` | ≥120px rendered surfaces: app icon (`icon-tile.svg`), splash, OG image, landing hero moments, share-card-adjacent art. Layers: wide bloom (blur 10, op .32) → tight glow (blur 4.5, op .6) → glass track `#161F30` + top highlight → crisp sweep → sheen (white .16, w 4.5) → marker halo + bezel `#0F172A` + enamel radial core + specular dot. |
| **Flat** | `assets/brand/dial-flat-dark.svg` / `dial-flat-light.svg` | Everything small or constrained: favicons, nav marks, in-app `logoMark()`, emails, function pages. |

### Flat variant colors

| Variant | Track | Progress | Bezel | Core |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| On dark | `rgba(255,255,255,0.16)` | sweep (tip `#60A5FA`) | `#0F172A` | `#FFFFFF` |
| On light | `#DCE7FB` | sweep (tip `#3B82F6`) | `#FFFFFF` + `stroke #DBEAFE 1.5` | `#2563EB` |
| Monochrome (android) | white flat dial, alpha carries shape | | | |

## Wordmark — two-tone, everywhere

**Plus Jakarta Sans 800, letter-spacing -0.04em**, one string `OnStandard`:
- **On** in ink — `#EEF3FB` on dark, `#0F172A` on light.
- **Standard** filled with the signature sweep (`linear-gradient(90deg,#34D399,#22D3EE,#3B82F6)`
  via background-clip:text on web; canvas gradient fill in the share card).
- **Email fallback**: gradient text is unreliable in mail clients — "Standard" is solid
  Athlete Blue `#2563EB` in emails. The mark in emails is the hosted PNG
  `https://onstandard.app/assets/brand/email-mark.png` (Gmail strips inline SVG).

Lockup ratios: gap ≈ 0.32× mark height, mark ≈ 1.6× wordmark cap height.

**Retired (never reintroduce):** ONSTANDARD all-caps lockups, single-tone mixed-case
lockups, the email checkmark-in-square, plain gradient-square "marks" (t.html/admin),
the check-ring of the deleted `Logo.tsx`, the blue-only gradient. ("OnStandard" as the
90+ score tier name is copy, not a lockup — it stays.)

## Color law

Sweep `#34D399 / #22D3EE / #3B82F6` (`#60A5FA` on-dark tip) · Athlete Blue `#2563EB`
(light primary) / `#3B82F6` (dark) · canvas `#070B14` · wash `#0F1B33` · ink `#0F172A` /
`#EEF3FB` · icon tile radius ≈ 24% of side.
**Banned hexes** (grep for these in reviews): `#E8B44A #F5C866 #C4922E` (landing gold era),
`#3d7dff #2fd4c8` (old t.html), `#33c6d6` (old admin), `#1E50D6` (pre-rename blue).

## Canonical embeds

- **Web pages**: inline flat-dial SVG with its OWN `<defs>` and a unique gradient id per
  instance (a shared id across two SVGs breaks when one is removed — this bug shipped in
  the landing footer once), plus `On<b>Standard</b>` two-tone spans.
- **Proto app**: `logoMark(size, uid)` in `proto/redesign-2026-07/js/components.js` —
  theme-adaptive, mirrors the flat masters exactly.
- **Share card**: `share-card.js` draws the dial via Path2D + two-tone wordmark on canvas.
- **CSS-only contexts** (admin `.mark`): the flat dial as a `data:image/svg+xml` background.
